summary.source_quote: Overactivity of the thyroid gland (Graves' disease) resulting in excessive secretion of thyroid hormones. The disease can originate from outside the thyroid.
summary.value: Overactivity of the thyroid gland (Graves' disease) resulting in excessive secretion of thyroid hormones. The disease can originate from outside the thyroid.

symptoms.source_quote: Goitre, abnormal basal metabolic rate, anxiety, nervous irritability, sweating, tremor, tachycardia, palpitations, exophthalmos, weight loss. / Graves' disease / Basedow's disease: Graves' ophthalmopathy, infiltrative dermopathy (localized or pretibial myxedema).
